rules.content:
title: Pig Butchering Domain Infrastructure Clustering
status: experimental
description: Detect clusters of domains exhibiting pig butchering investment platform characteristics: similar page structures, cryptocurrency wallet integration, registration through privacy-protected registrars,
logsource:
    product: dns_intelligence
    category: domain_clustering
    service: zone_file_diff
detection:
    selection:
        domain_cluster|contains:
            - "investment_keywords"
        shared_registrar: true
        privacy_protected_whois: true
        cname_density|gt: "threshold"
    condition: selection
level: high
rules.title: DL-0108: Pig Butchering Domain Infrastructure Clustering (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: Scam Compound Cryptocurrency Payment Infrastructure
status: experimental
description: Detect domain clusters with cryptocurrency payment page patterns (wallet address display, QR code generation, transaction verification) registered in bulk through shared registrar/nameserver infrastru
logsource:
    product: dns_intelligence
    category: payment_infrastructure
    service: ct_log
detection:
    selection:
        bulk_registered_domains: true
        crypto_payment_indicators: true
        shared_ns_infrastructure: true
    condition: selection and certificate_correlation
level: high
rules.title: DL-0109: Scam Compound Cryptocurrency Payment Infrastructure (Sigma)
